preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 30 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 1000 for N in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For every test case, N is an integer between 2 and 1000 inclusive.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 1000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= N and x in seen and (seen.add(x) or True) for x in nums) and len(seen) == N for (N, nums) in zip(test_cases, [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in output_lines]))
postconditions.description: Each output line is a permutation of {1, 2, ..., N} for the corresponding test case N.

postconditions.expression: all(all(median(prefix(i)) != median(prefix(i+1)) for i in range(1, N)) for (N, nums) in zip(test_cases, [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in output_lines]))
postconditions.description: For each permutation, the median of every prefix of length i is different from the median of the prefix of length i+1, for all 1 <= i < N.
